Launch, Upgrade, and Conquer the Skies with your plane!


Prepare for an exhilarating aerial adventure in Epic Plane Evolution, where your piloting skills and strategic upgrades determine how far your aircraft can soar. Launch your plane, navigate through diverse terrains, and evolve your aircraft to achieve maximum distance. Whether you're a casual gamer or a flight enthusiast, this game offers a captivating blend of action and strategy.


Epic Plane Evolution is a physics-based flight game that challenges players to launch their aircraft using a slingshot mechanism and guide it through various environments. As you progress, collect coins to upgrade your plane's components, enhancing its performance and unlocking new flight capabilities. Each level introduces unique challenges, requiring precise timing and strategic upgrades to succeed.



Slingshot Launch Mechanics
Initiate each flight by pulling back your plane on a slingshot, determining the initial speed and angle. Mastering this mechanic is crucial for achieving optimal flight paths and distances.


Aircraft Evolution and Upgrades
Accumulate coins during flights to invest in upgrades such as wings, engines, and fuselage enhancements. These improvements not only boost your plane's performance but also unlock new visual designs and capabilities.


Diverse Environments
Navigate through a variety of terrains, each presenting unique obstacles and weather conditions. Adapt your flight strategy to overcome challenges like wind currents, mountainous regions, and urban landscapes.


Strategic Flight Control
While airborne, adjust your plane's pitch and angle to maintain momentum and avoid obstacles. Strategic in-flight decisions can significantly impact your flight distance and coin collection.


Rewarding Progression System
Earn coins based on the distance traveled and successful navigation through obstacles. Use these earnings to continuously upgrade your aircraft, pushing the boundaries of how far you can fly.


Daily Challenges and Rewards
Engage in daily missions that offer additional rewards, encouraging consistent play and providing opportunities to test new strategies and upgrades.


Download and Take Flight!
Embark on your aviation journey today. Download Epic Plane Evolution and experience the thrill of launching, upgrading, and mastering the skies. How far can you fly?

Step into Creasewind, a handmade paper world where you are the postman and your paper plane is the mail van. Hold to climb, hold to dive, let go to glide — that is the whole control scheme. Thread the gaps, sweep up the coins, and drop your letter neatly into the mailbox at the end of the route.

Fold & Deliver
Two buttons, nothing else. Press and hold to ascend, hold the other to descend, release and the plane levels off on its own. Every route is a single clean line through walls, gates, drifting balloons and open sky — miss the mailbox and the run is over, so the last approach is always the one that counts.

Four Paper Regions
Eighty routes across four handcrafted chapters, each with its own scenery and its own pace:
Town Morning — red roofs, windmills and an easy breeze.
Garden Route — hedges close in and the gates start to move.
Coastal Mail — sea air, tighter gaps, balloons on the wind.
Snowy Peaks — the fastest air on the map, and the longest fall.

Three Hearts, Three Stars
Each route gives you three hearts. Clip a wall and you lose one and restart the route; lose all three and the delivery fails. Reach the mailbox for your first star, collect 70% of the coins for your second, and take every last one for the third.

Endless Flight
Pay a hundred coins and fly a route with no finish line. The world speeds up the further you go, the scenery rolls through all four regions, and one mistake ends the run. Distance, coins and personal bests all pay out — and beating your record pays a bonus.

Fold Your Own Style
Spend what you earn on ten paper planes, five flight trails and five control skins. Dotted ink, paper confetti, a rainbow ribbon or a haze of gold dust — pick the tail you want to leave behind you.

Daily Rounds
Daily and main tasks keep the coins coming, and every clear adds XP toward a pilot level that climbs to 30.

You'll start with basic airplane and gradually get to modern jet fighter. If you want to dive into the world of warplanes and warships, feel 1939-1945 fights and air duels, then this arcade warplane simulator game is for you.

results.description:
Get ready for explosive action in Angry Plane!
Launch into the skies, drop bombs on your targets, and upgrade your aircraft in this thrilling arcade-style flying game. Can you evolve your plane into the ultimate war machine?

Key Features:

Simple controls, high-flying fun
Tap to take off, fly across vibrant maps, and aim for destruction!

Upgrade and evolve your plane
Earn coins to boost your bomber’s power, speed, and explosive potential.

Unlock epic new aircraft
From vintage planes to futuristic war jets, collect and fly them all!

Complete daring missions
Challenge your skills with increasingly tough objectives and big rewards.

Play anytime, anywhere
No internet required. Instant fun on the go!

Whether you're a casual gamer or a flight combat enthusiast, Angry Plane delivers fast-paced fun and endless upgrade possibilities. Fly your way to victory and become the ultimate aerial destroyer!

Download Angry Plane now and rule the skies!

Fly 40 different routes with your choice of more than 15 airliners to earn stars, beat the clock and explore lush, detailed locations.

-40 exciting levels!
-15+ branded aircraft!
-Gorgeous graphics and locations!
-Free play mode to explore and practice!
-Awesome explosions!
-User-adjustable layouts and settings!

Easy to pick up and difficult to master; great fun for all ages!
